request.description: The warrior performs one fast overhead chopping slash with the sword in his forward hand, then recovers into his initial low crouched stance. He first draws that arm up beside his head, holds a brief wind-up, chops diagonally downward and outward toward the lower left, follows through, and settles back. The other sword stays behind him in the rear hand as a guard throughout. The blades keep their original length and curved shape, no glowing trails, no energy arcs. Feet stay planted; upper body twists with the chop. Burial cloth follows the turn. Camera fixed. Keep full figure inside frame.
